# @ndigo/log

Isomorphic logging core for Ndigo — logger abstraction, severity mappings, and threshold filtering on the OpenTelemetry API

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `LogAttributes` *(type)* — Represents a collection of attributes to be associated with a log entry. These attributes provide additional context and metadata for the log.
- `Logger` *(type)* — Defines the interface for a logger that supports different severity levels and structured logging.
- `LoggerType` *(type)* — Defines the available types of loggers that can be created by the `LoggerFactory`. - `'open-telemetry'`: Uses OpenTelemetry for logging. - `'console'`: Logs di…
- `LoggerFactory` — A static factory class for creating `Logger` instances.
- `getLogger` — A convenience function to get a `Logger` instance from the `LoggerFactory`.
- `LogEntry` *(type)* — Represents a single log entry with structured information. This interface defines the common properties expected for a log record, including severity, message…
- `ContextAwareLogger` — A decorator logger that automatically injects OpenTelemetry trace and span IDs into log attributes if an active span is present in the current context.
- `SeverityScheme` *(type)* — Defines the supported severity schemes for mapping log levels. - `'syslog'`: Standard Unix syslog severity levels. - `'npm'`: Severity levels used by npm. - `'…
- `SeverityMapping` *(type)* — Defines an interface for mapping between string-based log level names and OpenTelemetry `SeverityNumber`s.
- `getSeverityMapping` — Retrieves the `SeverityMapping` instance for a given severity scheme.
- `detectSeverityScheme` — Attempts to detect the `SeverityScheme` based on a given log level name. This function uses a heuristic to guess the most likely scheme.
- `levelToSeverityNumber` — Converts a string-based log level name to its corresponding OpenTelemetry `SeverityNumber`. If a scheme is not provided, it attempts to detect the scheme autom…
- `severityNumberToLevel` — Converts an OpenTelemetry `SeverityNumber` to its corresponding string-based log level name.
- `levelToSeverityText` — Converts a string-based log level name to its corresponding severity text, first converting to `SeverityNumber` and then back to text. If a scheme is not provi…
- `loggerSeverityMethodNames` — A read-only array of method names on the `Logger` interface that correspond to severity levels.
- `LOGGER_LEVEL_NAMES` — The canonical level names, sorted. `LOGGER_THRESHOLDS` keys — the vocabulary `/loggers` advertises and accepts.
- `resolveLoggerLevel` — Resolves a level name to its threshold severity, strictly.
- `loggerLevelName` — Renders a threshold severity back to its canonical level name.
